facts.detail: BDUK began reporting delivery performance as official statistics in 2025.
Quarterly official statistics contain a subset of the annual tables.
The collection includes annual April 2025 to March 2026 statistics.
It includes October to December 2025 quarterly statistics.
It includes April to September 2025 quarterly statistics.
It includes annual April 2024 to March 2025 statistics.
It includes the April to December 2024 quarterly release.
The collection was published on 24 July 2025.
The collection was last updated on 11 June 2026.
A link to contract-delivery management information was added in October 2025.

guard_streams.source: Building Digital UK Annual Report and Accounts 2024 to 2025
guard_streams.write_limit: Annual-report programme totals, accounting measures and national coverage milestones cannot verify current serviceability or speed for selected parcels.

facts.detail: During the reporting period BDUK was a DSIT executive agency.
The report states BDUK would integrate into DSIT from 1 November 2025.
BDUK reported achieving the interim 85 percent gigabit-coverage target.
It reported more than 87 percent of UK homes and businesses with gigabit access by March 2025.
A Project Gigabit premises pass requires service at standard price and standard connection timescale.
Prior-year delivery was revised using higher-quality voucher-supplier data.
The counting method excludes premises expected to be commercial or already delivered by another supplier.
Total Project Gigabit capital spend for 2024/25 was reported as £253.8 million.
Shared Rural Network capital spend for 2024/25 was reported as £13.8 million.
The report describes a voucher expansion trial announced in March 2025 and launched in initial urban areas in April.

guard_streams.source: Project Gigabit network build contract - East and West Sussex
guard_streams.write_limit: Contract scope, redesign and planned premises are procurement evidence. They do not prove present-day orderability or measured speed for selected parcels.

facts.detail: The East and West Sussex contract page was published on 6 February 2024.
It was last updated on 26 May 2026.
The original contract covered around 52,000 premises.
The original CityFibre contract value was £100 million.
The original contract was signed in January 2024.
CityFibre and BDUK redesigned the contract in May 2026.
The redesigned contract covers around 13,000 premises.
The redesigned investment is £25.2 million.
The redesign aims to minimise overlap with commercial rollout.
The premises list remains subject to supplier planning and technical change.
